title: Autonomous repo bugfix scan
summary: Fix a coherent batch of repo-scan defects: Local API/Tauri route drift, an observability dependency-boundary violation, stale WebView/static test expectations, WebView lint-budget drift, duplicate-test-name report drift, and failure-artifact cleanup route/config/schema documentation drift.
reason: Broad autonomous validation found high-confidence regressions where checked contracts, generated artifacts, tests, or guardrails no longer matched executable source. The fixes keep mutation ownership and strict backend confirmations intact while restoring validation health.
behavior_before: Validation failed on a missing Tauri read-route contract entry, a forbidden observability-to-status dependency, stale generated duplicate-test output, stale WebView assertions, WebView ESLint budget drift, and failure-artifact cleanup route/config/schema inventory mismatches.
behavior_after: The Tauri shell advertises the backend failure-artifact read route, observability no longer imports through the forbidden status package boundary, WebView lint/static checks are current, generated navigation and WebView artifacts are refreshed, and failure-artifact cleanup route/config/schema inventories match the backend contract.

apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe -m unittest discover -s tests/python -q -> OK (2639 tests, skipped=1).
npm run webview:prework:check -> OK, including WebView lint budget 621/624 warnings, generated WebView maps/contracts, command-boundary checks, and script-order smoke.
apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe ops/scripts/dev/run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.dev.refresh_summaries --check -> OK, 1994 source files current.
rollback_plan: Revert the listed source, test, schema, inventory, and generated-context files for this packet, then rerun WebView generated-artifact checks, config schema generation, summary/index refresh checks, and the targeted unittest commands before retrying the scan.
